lidar.binning: beam angle a (rad, CCW, 0 = forward) wrapped to [-pi, pi) goes to bin floor((a + pi) / (2 pi / bins)); each bin is the min valid range; returns that are non-finite, outside [range_min, range_max] of the scan or below min_range count as max_range; then clip to max_range and divide by it

camera.binning: points (camera_optical_frame) with optical-axis depth z in [min_depth, max_depth] are moved to base_link; with bearing b = atan2(y, x) and range r = hypot(x, y) (both from base_link's origin), those with height z in [min_height + min_height_per_m * r, max_height] are obstacles; points with |b| < hfov/2 go to bin floor((b + hfov/2) / (hfov / bins)), each bin is the min r; empty bins are max_range; then clip to max_range and divide by it

observation: goal in base frame (x fwd, y left) from odometry, m / goal_obs_scale
last clamped actions, newest first, (fwd, turn) pairs
binned stereo obstacle points, 0-1, bin 0 = rightmost
